## 2026-10-30 — S1374 CORRECTION: D5-D9 signature typing (append; supersedes the S1367 S1360 row)

S1360's three `_false` theorems exposed an inconsistent full-signature
assumption in the D5-D9 records.  The fix is in
`LeanFormal/IUT/IUTI/InitialTheta/SourceDefinition31Quantifiers.lean`:

- `SourceOrbicurveScalarExtension` keeps `result`, `stackExtension`,
  `target_stack` and `genus_preserved`; it no longer stores
  `stackyOrders_preserved` or `punctures_preserved`.
- `SourceOrbicurveScalarExtension.signature_preserved` is removed;
  `signature_genus_preserved` records the only preserved invariant.
- `SourceSignQuotientData.xK_signature` / `cK_signature` now return the
  paper types `sourceTypeOneLTorsion l` / `sourceTypeOneLTorsionPlusMinus l`;
  `xK_genus`, `cK_genus` and `cF_genus` are the genus consequences.

Paper semantics (IUT I, Definition 3.1(b),(d)): `X_F`/`C_F` are the
F-side `(1,1)` / `(1,1)^\pm` objects; the K-core base change gives
`X_K`/`C_K` of type `(1,l-tors)` / `(1,l-tors)^\pm`; the coarse base
change preserves only the genus, while the l-torsion decoration is
additional.  Retyping the F-side as `(1,l-tors)` was rejected.

## S1519: concrete Gaussian native Theta data has no inhabitant (2026-10-31)

- Task: construct an actual SourceNativeInitialThetaData over S1280Arithmetic l
  (concrete Gaussian Q(i) arithmetic) or name the exact first missing native
  field.
- Result: the structure is empty; the exact first failing native field is
  clause (c), SourceClauseC.  This is not a missing field to be filled later.
- Proof: concreteGaussianInitialThetaArithmeticData has Fmod = F = K = Q(i), so
  K is F-algebra equivalent to F.  Clause (c)'s kernel_field_identification
  identifies K with the fixed field L of the l-torsion representation kernel;
  finrank A.F L = 1, hence L = F and the representation kernel is top, so the
  representation is trivial and its range is bottom.  Clause (c)'s
  image_contains_SL2 then puts the nontrivial unipotent matrix !![1,1;0,1]
  into bottom, a contradiction.  No earlier tuple/place data can repair it.
- Consequence: S1503 NativeBridgeExact and NativeInputBridgeExact are empty
  over S1280Arithmetic l; S1497's native donor cannot be built from this root.
  A source-faithful arithmetic root must use the actual K = l-torsion kernel
  field (so K != F for nontrivial SL2 image), or S1280Arithmetic must be
  corrected; no fake or degenerate T is used.
